title: Larger root of a factored quadratic
source: Theory P1-1.7 Quick check 1 (larger root of (x-2)(x-7)=0 is 7); book Worked example 1.15 style pp.22-23, new numbers
stem: The inequality \((x-{p|int})(x-{q|int})<0\) holds between the roots. What is the larger root?

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: The roots are \({p|int}\) and \({q|int}\), so the larger root is \({q|int}\).
steps.note: q is chosen larger than p.

title: Smaller root of a monic quadratic
source: Theory P1-1.7 Quick check 2 (smaller root of x^2-5x+6=0 is 2); book factorisation step, new numbers
stem: Solve \(x^2-{B|int}x+{C|int}=0\). What is the smaller root?

steps.name: A
steps.note: p is the smaller root because q>=p+1.

contexts.note: Includes the original p=2, q=3, giving x^2-5x+6

title: How many integers lie strictly between two bounds
source: Theory P1-1.7 Quick check 3 (three integers satisfy 1<x<5); counting integers in an open interval, new numbers

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: The integers run from \({a|int}+1\) to \({B|int}-1\), so there are \({n|int}\) of them.
steps.note: B = a+n+1, so the number of integers strictly between a and B is n. Original: 1<x<5, n=3.

contexts.note: Includes the original a=1, n=3, B=5

title: Set of values for a quadratic inequality

source.note: Stem taken from the QP PDF (UCLES 2016), Question 11(i) only. Official answer and mark allocation from the MS PDF. The item is paper/self-mark. Later parts of Question 11 are omitted (they concern a line meeting the curve and a restricted domain).

stem:
This question is 9709/12/M/J/16 Question 11(i), taken from the official QP.

The function \(f\) is defined by \(f:x\mapsto 6x-x^2-5\) for \(x\in\mathbb{R}\).

Find the set of values of \(x\) for which \(f(x)\leqslant 3\).  [3]

steps.name: M
steps.note: MS: M1 for rearranging to a quadratic inequality in x and attempting to solve.

steps.name: A1
steps.note: MS: A1 for both values 2 and 4.

steps.name: A
steps.note: MS: A1 for x <= 2, x >= 4, with recognisable notation; condone < and/or >. Independent check: 6x-x^2-5 <= 3 iff x^2-6x+8 >= 0 iff (x-2)(x-4) >= 0, so x<=2 or x>=4. The official domain is all real x (the QP uses the real-number symbol).
